body.p: The following listing of claims replaces all prior versions thereof. Changes are shown below in highlighted form, where insertions appear as underlined text (e.g., insertions) while deletions appear as strikethrough text (e.g., deletions) or double brackets (e.g., [[deletions]]).

br.br:
1.-15. (Canceled)214
16. (Currently Amended) A method for displaying a health parameter of a user, the method comprising:measuring, with an optical sensor, raw data responsive to detection of an interaction of emitted light with a skin of a user;
determining one or more physiological measurements from the measured raw data acquired by the optical sensor with a first software;
downloading a second software, wherein the second software is configured to execute one or more post-processing functions on the determined one or more physiological measurements;
providing, with the first software, an option in a first graphical user interface presented on a display for a user to select a determination of a health parameter that is specific to the second software;selecting the second software for the determination of the health parameter;
receiving an indication that the second software was selected from the option in the graphical user interface;
enabling the second software to execute the one or more post-processing functions on the determined one or more physiological parameters based on the selection of the second software, wherein the one or more post-processing functions are configured to determine the health parameter; and
displaying, on a second graphical user interface, the health parameter on a display along with the one or more physiological parameters determined by the first software,
wherein the second graphical user interface is generated by the first software.
17. (Previously Presented) The method of Claim 16, further comprising generating a format for the determined one or more physiological parameters to enable the one or more post-processing functions by the second software.
18. (Previously Presented) The method of Claim 16, wherein the determination of the one or more physiological measurements is separate from the post-processing functions.
19. (Previously Presented) The method of Claim 16, wherein the post-processing functions include producing alerts on the display.
20. (Previously Presented) The method of Claim 16, wherein the health parameter is proprietary to the second software.
21. (Previously Presented) The method of Claim 16, further comprising displaying the health parameter as determined by the second software and the one or more physiological measurements as determined by the first software simultaneously on the display.
22. (Previously Presented) The method of Claim 16, further comprising running the second software simultaneously with the first software.
23. (Previously Presented) The method of Claim 16, wherein the second software is configured to operate with the first software or in conjunction with a virtual machine.
24. (Previously Presented) The method of Claim 16, wherein the health parameter comprises a wellness indicator specific to the second software.
